# Postalytics

Direct Mail Automation software in the cloud with deep integration to CRM and workflows, making direct mail look, act and feel like a digital marketing channel

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/postalytics/.

## Actions

- **Add Account**: Create a new sub-account in the Postalytics system.
- **Add Contact**: Add a contact to a specified contact list with their information.
- **Create New Campaign**: Create a new direct mail campaign in Postalytics.
- **Create Suppression List**: Create a new suppression list that can be used in campaigns to suppress contacts from being sent mail.
- **Create Suppression List Contact**: Create a new suppression contact on a specified suppression list.
- **Create Template**: Create a new template with full HTML for postcard or letter.
- **Create Webhook**: Create a new webhook to receive campaign event notifications from Postalytics.
- **Delete Account**: Delete a Postalytics account and all associated campaigns, templates, and lists.
- **Delete Campaign**: Delete a campaign from the system.
- **Delete Suppression List**: Delete a specified suppression list.
- **Delete Suppression List Contact**: Delete a specific contact from a suppression list.
- **Get All Contact Lists** (read-only): Retrieve all contact lists for an account.
- **Get All Contacts on a List** (read-only): Retrieve all contacts from a specified contact list with pagination support.
- **Get All Drip Campaigns** (read-only): Retrieve all triggered drip campaign names and endpoint IDs in the account.
- **Get All Flows** (read-only): Retrieve all flows for the requester's account.
- **Get My Account** (read-only): Retrieve basic account information for the authenticated user.
- **Get Suppression List** (read-only): Get the details of a suppression list based on the id supplied.
- **Get Suppression Lists** (read-only): Retrieve all suppression lists for the authenticated user.
- **Update Account**: Update an existing account in the Postalytics system.
- **Update Suppression List Contact**: Update a suppression contact on the specified suppression list.
- **Get All Webhooks** (read-only): Retrieve all webhooks configured for the authenticated account.
- **Get Integrations** (read-only): Retrieve all Connect integrations configured for the authenticated user's account.
- **Get Suppression List Contact** (read-only): Retrieve a specific contact from a suppression list.
- **Get Suppression List Contacts** (read-only): Get all contacts on a specified suppression list.
